_comment: First-season continental fields. The career opens after the 2026 calendar year of CONMEBOL/CONCACAF/OFC has started, so the first career season replays the 2026 edition as its own first edition, shifted into the career season. Clubs are Transfermarkt ids from open_football.sqlite; an association whose league is not in the database is listed under `missing` and the field is shorter by that club. Sources: the 2026 competition pages on Wikipedia (see docs/research/competition-formats/access-world.json for the access rules).
